description: Inspecting the radio tower during a weather hold before departure, the Logistics Officer found the prior year's roof sealing work still holding and robust, but noted that better climbing equipment would be needed to safely seal the rest of the roof in a future season.
response: None during this mission; noted for future planning.
lesson: Budget for proper roof-access climbing equipment (not improvised tower-climbing) before attempting further roof sealing work in a future mission.
